verdict.rationale: PagerDuty ships an official MCP server (pagerduty-mcp-server) plus a documented REST/Events API that explicitly supports triggering, acknowledging, and resolving incidents programmatically, and escalation is automated via escalation policies — enabling agent-driven incident handling without a dashboard. Evidence includes first-party docs for MCP setup with Claude/Cursor/VS Code and API endpoints for the full incident lifecycle. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that an agent can complete a full incident lifecycle purely via MCP/API without any UI fallback, and no third-party corroboration of the MCP server's reliability in production.
